title: Hub weather strip: one town per district, no repeats
why: Jason's screenshot, 2026-11-19: a hub's weather strip showed The Show Low District and then Albuquerque four times. Guides::stripTowns took the hub's districts' places, sorted all of them by listings and kept the first 5, so one busy district filled the strip and nothing skipped repeats. Now (Guides::stripPick, testable without the database): one place per district first, best by listings, then the best left; a town already shown is skipped by name ("The" ignored) and by a point within about 2 km. Same 5 at most, same cards. Test: tools/design-tests/strip-towns.php (8 pass).

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
